title: Workbook auto-generation
description: Creates ready-to-use Azure Workbooks tailored to a specific workload's monitoring needs.
example_prompt: "Generate an Azure Workbook for workload in resource group '{rg_name}'. Auto-detect resource types and include relevant panels: (1) resource health overview, (2) key performance metrics per resource type, (3) error/exception trends, (4) cost trend, (5) recent changes. Export as ARM template for deployment."
